## 1. Acceptance By using Raven Components you agree to be delighted by springs.
## 2. Widgets Widgets are provided as they are. They may bounce, squash, fly in or pop out of what opened them.
## 3. Themes You may wear any look: macOS, Windows 11, GNOME or Raven, dark or light, solid or glass.
## 4. Live reload Saving an XML file while the app runs changes the window. This is a feature.
## 5. Data No data leaves your computer. The data table is made up; the people in it are famous.
## 6. Termination Press Escape at any time.
